text:
leigh.prodeng: FYI were publishing a small billing policy change next week: were retiring automatic free onboarding credits for new self-serve orgs and updating invoice exports. Please scan and flag blockers.

billing-bot: [Draft] /drafts/billing-2026-freecredit-sunset (internal preview)

omar.billing: Key points: (1) New signups after 2026-05-01 will not receive platform-issued free credits; existing credits are honored until expiry. (2) Invoice CSV will include explicit line_type (token/embed/storage) and region_code columns; files will include header `schema_version=2`.

leigh.prodeng: This is a program simplification, not a price change. Well offer targeted onboarding discounts for teams likely to churn.

engops.lee: Ops change: hosted rate-limit warnings will be emitted at 85% by default; well enforce a soft-throttle at 125% to prevent billing surprises. Dedicated accounts unchanged.

omar.billing: Rollout plan: internal note today, public blog & help center article 2026-04-28, emails to impacted orgs 2026-04-30, export schema migration 2026-05-03 02:00-03:00 UTC (expect brief export failures).

leigh.prodeng: Action items
- Comms: finalize external copy and FAQ.
- Support: canned replies and refund flow.
- Eng: add region_code + schema_version to CSV exports and bump export semver.

omar.billing: Draft customer line: "Your active credits remain valid until they expire. From May 1 new signups will no longer receive automatic onboarding credits; contact us for a welcome discount."

leigh.prodeng: Please avoid "canceling trials" phrasing. Legal + finance have reviewed; final signoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:
